crossRefs.note: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
When they heard it, they marveled, and left him, and went away.
On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,
He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.
He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear, and the mute…
They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”
They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who…
All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and…
Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things…
I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame…
For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we…
But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of…
I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him…
They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

translations.web: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—
translations.bsb: Just as many were appalled at Him — His appearance was disfigured beyond that of any man, and His form was marred beyond human likeness—
translations.kjv: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
translations.asv: Like as many were astonished at thee (his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men),
